name: Me'a Tanaki Status Report
query:
SELECT
    nt.name AS "Record ID:Link/Ngaue Tanaki:180",
    nt.student AS "Student:Link/Student:180",
    COALESCE(s.student_name, nt.student) AS "Student Name:Data:180",
    COALESCE(i.item_name, nt.mea_tanaki) AS "Me'a Tanaki:Data:150",
    nt.due_date AS "Due Date:Date:110",
    CASE
        WHEN nt.submitted = 1 THEN 'Submitted'
        WHEN nt.due_date < CURDATE() THEN 'Overdue'
        ELSE 'Pending'
    END AS "Status:Data:110",
    nt.responsible_teacher AS "Responsible Teacher:Link/Instructor:180",
    nt.reminder_sent AS "Reminder Sent:Check:100",
    nt.reminder_sent_on AS "Reminder Sent On:Date:130",
    nt.submitted_date AS "Submitted Date:Date:130"
FROM `tabNgaue Tanaki` nt
LEFT JOIN `tabStudent` s ON s.name = nt.student
LEFT JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = nt.mea_tanaki
ORDER BY nt.due_date ASC, nt.student ASC
